audited.name: Allgaeuer Kraftwerke GmbH
audited.result: Fresh station-level chargecloud/Mobilithek discovery expands the exact EVSE matrix materially without tariff extrapolation. Am Anger 9 is DE*738*E00011*001/002 at 0.51 EUR/kWh AC; Gruentenstrasse 7 is DE*738*E00009*001/002 at 0.51 EUR/kWh AC; Bahnhofsplatz 10 exposes DE*738*E00012*001/002, DE*738*E00037*001 and DE*738*E00038*001/002 at 0.51 EUR/kWh AC; Am Alten Bahnhof 10 is DE*738*E00003*001/002 at 0.51 EUR/kWh AC; Am Alten Bahnhof 10A remains DE*738*E00033*001/002 at 0.57 EUR/kWh DC. Additional current Mobilithek-derived identity evidence confirms Quartier Jahnstrasse DE*738*E00008*001/002, Sonthofener Strasse 11 DE*738*E00006*001/002, Im Wasen DE*738*E00029*001/002 and Johann-Althaus-Strasse AC DE*738*E00010*001/002. Rudolf-Diesel-Strasse 3 has current Mobilithek-derived station-level tariff evidence at 0.51 EUR/kWh AC plus a 1.00 EUR start fee and no blocking fee, demonstrating that fee components can vary and must be preserved per station. No network-wide zero-start-fee assumption is allowed.
